messages:
DeployBot: deploy-check: promotion to prod paused for release r-2026-03-20. Problem: configmap key mismatch on prod for runtime-config -> missing `inference.model_map` JSON. Canary flagged increased 502 rate. @Kai @Maria
Kai: reading the cms now. staging has `model_map_v2` (JSON object). prod has `model_map` as a single string token. that's why runtime can't parse.
DeployBot: detected at deploy preflight: `runtime parse error: expected object at inference.model_map` logs attached.
Maria: :eyes: that would break model-variant routing. Canary traffic saw 2.8% 502s in the last 5m on pod inference-3.
Jamal: agree, do not promote. Options: 1) backfill prod CM with normalized JSON mapping, 2) rollback canary to previous image sha (sha:abc1234), 3) patch runtime to accept both formats (deploy later).
Kai: change window is open for 15 more mins. I can run a safe backfill job to convert the string to the JSON object the runtime expects, and also pin the image for promotion stage.
Ops Oncall: if doing backfill, need audit log and a reversible plan. create a k8s Job or a `kubectl patch` with dry-run first. Also update release notes and create ticket INF-745 for post-rollout validation.
Kai: testing dry-run now:
```
kubectl get cm runtime-config -n inference -o json | jq '.data["model_map"] | fromjson' # dry-run parse
```
Dry-run parses fine when I coerce.
Kai: backfill command I will run (patch merge):
```
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"model_map":"$(cat mapping.json | jq -c .)"}}'
```
Maria: :thumbsup: after backfill, run canary traffic soak for 10m, then re-evaluate.
DeployBot: release state: PAUSED -> awaiting `prod-config-backfill` confirmation from @Kai.
ReleaseCoordinatorBot: noted. Logging hold and preventing automatic promotion. Notifying stakeholders.
Kai: running patch in 2m, will post results here. If anything looks off I'll rollback the patch to previous CM version (kubectl get cm -o yaml before applying).
Jamal: also prep rollback image pin just in case: `image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:20260320-rc2-abc1234` ready.
Ops Oncall: make sure to capture timestamped audit and add post-deploy monitors for p95 latency and 502s.
Kai: patch applied. initial validation: canary 502 -> 0.4% over 5m, no new errors in runtime logs.
Maria: good. hold release until soak completes, then we'll approve promotion. I'll update the release notes with the config normalization step.
DeployBot: promotion remains blocked until approval. tagging: @ReleaseCoordinatorBot @Ops Oncall
